actual_request.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Produce one complete full-body 1024x1024 or larger transparent PNG game sprite, one new articulated walking phase.
Image 1 is the editable NE character design. Keep her upper body, equipment, face direction, hair, crown, colors, compact chibi proportions, robe details and all upper-body geometry unchanged. Image 2 is authoritative original-character identity. Image 3 is approved primary hand-painted rendering style.
Change ONLY the articulation of the two legs below the robe into the OPPOSITE PASSING POSE:
The boot visible on the LEFT in image 1, currently lifted with its sole facing us, must now stand straight down, fully planted flat on the invisible ground and carry body weight. Hide its sole underside.
The boot visible on the RIGHT in image 1, currently planted and showing its star buckle, must now be visibly LIFTED, with knee bent forward toward the top-right heading. This lifted near/right boot passes close beside the planted far/left leg and PARTLY OVERLAPS it in front. Show the SIDE of the lifted boot, not a broad rear-facing sole.
This is phase05: LEFT far leg grounded support; RIGHT near leg passing forward. Both knees close together under the hips, one planted foot and one lifted foot. Draw clearly different support/overlap from image1. No long lunge, no jump.
Maintain exact back-right three-quarter NE heading and same camera scale, foot ground anchor around y=942 on1024 canvas. Full crown, equipment and both boots within margins. Newly draw articulated legs; no copy, mirror, warp, interpolation or translation of the previous pose. Genuine transparent alpha, clean edges, no red/purple edge fringe, no ground shadow, no labels.
